description: This file defines a class 'MorseCodeConverter' that provides methods to convert text characters into Morse code patterns. It includes predefined Morse code representations for letters A-Z and digits 0-9, along with methods to generate the pattern arrays for individual characters or strings.

classes.name: MorseCodeConverter
classes.description: Implements the text to Morse code conversion logic, including pattern generation for characters and strings.

methods.name: pattern
methods.description: Returns the Morse code pattern array for a given character or string, encoding the appropriate sequence of dots, dashes, and gaps.
